English: A ledger long forgotten in the depths of an abandoned counting house told of debts owed by merchants who had vanished decades earlier, their names scratched into brittle paper alongside sums of gold that no living soul could ever hope to collect, and yet the ledger remained, gathering dust in a drawer nobody thought to open, its pages yellowed and its binding cracked from years of neglect inside the old counting house nobody visited anymore since the merchants disappeared without a trace, leaving only silence behind them.
Japanese: 忘れられた帳簿の物語。

English: Coil of Distant Memory and Forgotten Song
Japanese: 遠い記憶と忘れられた歌のコイル
